work.summary: Investigated the report that motorway segments were not changing color. A real ORS driving-hgv Preview call between Nagoya IC and Komaki IC returned waycategory values containing motorway bit 1, confirming the color classifier is correct. FINAL.26 therefore preserves the classifier but makes route status and toll-avoidance state explicit, and adds portrait-only behavior for non-MAP mobile screens plus landscape/fullscreen MAP behavior with browser-compatible fallbacks.
